decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's established space optical and navigation capabilities, this camera fits its strong internal R&D base and research network, so management would expect to learn and improve rather than withdraw it quickly.

This modular camera line is very close to the firm's core knowledge and strategic move toward flexible spacecraft sensors, making it especially likely that management keeps it and develops the range further.

The sensor suite builds on the firm's existing spacecraft sensing and observation competences, and with high absorptive capacity from in-house R&D and university cooperation the firm is well placed to refine it instead of dropping it.

Although the miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor is still close to the firm's knowledge base, its lower website prominence suggests a somewhat earlier-stage market position, so management would keep it but with a higher withdrawal risk than the other products.
